methodologyNotes: Adversarially re-verified roster of nine real home dehumidifier models. Each price, release year, and headline spec was independently re-checked (June 2026) against manufacturer pages (Midea, Waykar, GE Appliances, Frigidaire, Honeywell), authorized resellers (Sylvane, Conservation Mart, Home Depot, Amazon), and independent hands-on reviews (HouseFresh, DehumidifierBuyersGuide, AlphaChooser). Capacity values use the current 2019 DOE standard (pints/day at 65F, 60% RH) unless noted. Booleans indicate feature present (true) / absent (false). noise_dba values are manufacturer-stated or reviewer-measured. Fields not confirmable from a directly accessed source are null, never estimated. All nine drafted models were confirmed to exist; none removed. Two corrections applied: Frigidaire FFAD5033W1 coverage filled (4,500 sq ft, confirmed mfr/retailers) and Midea Cube 50-pint base model price corrected (299->269.99 per Sylvane direct listing for the exact MAD50S1QWT bucket model). accessedAt 2026-06-15.

products.name: GE 50 Pint Portable Dehumidifier with Built-in Pump and Smart Dry APYR50LC
products.priceNote: $366.00 listed as Sale/Clearance on the GE Appliances official product page for APYR50LC (model no longer manufactured); no separate "Was"/MSRP figure was displayed. Town Appliance retailer listing showed $475.67 USD (marked DISCONTINUED).

The Town Appliance retailer listing (SKU APYR50LC, UPC 084691917076) mirrored GE's spec sheet, confirming 50 pints/day dehumidification ("Dehumidification (pts./day) 50 pt"), a 14-pt bucket capacity, Built-In Pump = Yes, Energy Star certification, a continuous/external drain connector (External Drain Connector = Yes), and sound levels of 47 dBA (low) / 50 dBA (max). The GE page itself only displayed dimensions, so the sound-level attribution now reflects the Town Appliance spec sheet as the actual source. Coverage area is not given as a specific square-footage figure on either fetched page, so coverage_sqft is left null. No release year is stated on any fetched page, so releaseDate is null. Correction from prior pass: the Town Appliance page did display a price ($475.67 USD, marked DISCONTINUED), not "no price" as previously noted.

products.name: Frigidaire Gallery 50 Pint 3-in-1 Dehumidifier with WiFi FGAC5045W1
products.priceNote: Park Ave Appliance (authorized dealer) listed "Regular price $316.66" for model FGAC5045W1; unit marked backordered/out of stock at access. Members-only retailers (Homery, Shop Appliances) did not display a public price. No manufacturer MSRP was fetchable.
products.provenance: Re-fetched and verified against authorized-dealer spec sheets for exact model FGAC5045W1 (frigidaire.com is JS-rendered, no extractable content). Both pages confirm the exact model number. Park Ave Appliance spec sheet confirmed verbatim: Dehumidification - Pints per Day 50; Pump Feature No; Continuous Drain Operation Yes; ENERGY STAR Certified Yes; Noise Level dBA Low 48.2 / Med 49 / High 51.5; Regular price $316.66; plus R-32 refrigerant. Homery independently confirmed 50 pint, Coverage Area Sq Ft 1200 (matching the shared Frigidaire bullet "areas up to 1,200 sq. ft."), continuous drain, and Energy Star. CORRECTION on adversarial re-verification: tank_capacity_pints=16.8 was NULLED — it is not stated verbatim on any fetched page. Both retailers list bucket capacity as "2.1 Gallons," and Homery's literal "Bucket Capacity Pint: 2.1" field states 2.1 pints, not 16.8; the 16.8 value was an author-side gallons-to-pints conversion, not text-supported, so it fails the verbatim standard. No release year is stated on any fetched page, so releaseDate remains null. 6 of 7 specKeys survive verification.

products.name: Midea Cube 20-Pint Smart Dehumidifier MAD20S1QWT

The Sylvane retailer page (exact model MAD20S1QWT, SKU mi16419) corroborated all of these (Internal Condensate Pump = No, Manufacturer-Suggested Room Size 1500, Pint Capacity 20.0) and additionally supplied the price ($189.99), Water Container Capacity 20 pints (nested lift-and-twist bucket design), Maximum Noise Level 45 dB, and Energy Star / ENERGY STAR Most Efficient certification plus "Continuous Drain Capable, Drain Hose Included." Note: the Sylvane spec table lists Maximum Noise Level in dB (not A-weighted dBA), so the noise value was corrected from "45 dBA" to "45 dB." No fetched page stated a release year, so releaseDate remains null. All 7 spec keys verified and retained; model is exact (not a sibling/other capacity).

products.name: Waykar 34-Pint 2,000 Sq. Ft. Energy Star Dehumidifier PD160B
products.priceNote: No single US price confirmable from a fetched exact-model page: the Amazon buy box for B081RG8JYR rendered in EUR at fetch time (no reliable USD figure for this ASIN). DehumidifierBuyersGuide's PD160B review states it is "usually priced ... in the $150 to $200 range," but that is a range, not a specific figure, so priceUsd left null rather than guessed.
products.provenance: The Amazon listing for the exact model (Model Number "PD160B," ASIN B081RG8JYR, sold by Waykar-US) confirms 34 pints/day at 95F/90% RH, up to 2,000 sq. ft. coverage, a 0.66-gallon (2.5 L) removable tank, ENERGY STAR certification, and a dual-drainage system with an included hose for continuous gravity drainage. DehumidifierBuyersGuide's hands-on review of the same PD160B independently states the tank "only has a capacity of 5.3 pints," confirms "This dehumidifier does not have a built-in pump" and a rear gravity-drain outlet, and measured noise at 59.1 dB (high) to 53.9 dB (low) near-field; it also notes the 34-pint headline is a max-condition rating ("It removes only 10 pints/day at 65F, 60% RH," the 2019 DOE standard), so capacity_pints_per_day retains the 34-pint nameplate consistent with the sibling Waykar entries. Amazon separately lists a 0.62-gallon "2025 Most Efficient" successor variant, so the exact-model B081RG8JYR page is used as source and the model-specific independent review as corroboration. releaseDate left null (Amazon lists a "Manufacture Year 2025" but no page states a product release/launch date) and priceUsd left null (no single US figure confirmable on a fetched exact-model page; Amazon rendered in EUR).

products.name: Frigidaire 50 Pint Dehumidifier with Built-in Pump FFAP5034W1
products.priceNote: Not sourced from a fetched page. The primary source (D&S Appliances) shows the model as "Item Not Available / Sold out" with no price displayed. Home Depot's listing appears in search at roughly $301.18, but its page returned HTTP 403 and no price-bearing page for this exact model could be fetched to confirm a figure verbatim, so price is left null.
products.provenance: D&S Appliances (dshomeappliances.com), an authorized dealer page that reproduces Frigidaire's official spec sheet verbatim, confirmed the exact model FFAP5034W1 (page header "FRIGIDAIRE FFAP5034W1" / "Frigidaire FFAP5034W1 50 Pint Dehumidifier with Pump (Energy Star® Certified)"): "Dehumidification - Pints per Day: 50", "Bucket Capacity: 2.2 Gallons", "Pump Feature: Yes" plus "Built-In Pump" feature, "Continuous Drain Operation: Yes", "ENERGY STAR Certified: Yes", and manufacturer-rated noise "Noise Level dBA (Low): 47 dBA / (Med): 49 dBA / (High): 51 dBA", plus "Refrigerant Type: R-32" and "Fan Speeds - Fan: 3". RTINGS' review page corroborated that FFAP5034W1 is a real, independently reviewed model listed distinctly from siblings FFAP5033W1 / FFAD5033W1 (its detailed spec table is member-gated). The Frigidaire manufacturer page is JS-rendered and returned no extractable text, and Home Depot, Best Buy, AJ Madison, Barons, Keith's, Lowe's and B&H all returned 403, so D&S is cited as the primary verbatim source. tank_capacity_pints=17.6 is the verbatim 2.2-gallon bucket converted to US pints (x8, exact), consistent with the catalog's existing gallon-to-pint methodology; coverage_sqft is null (no fetched page stated it, and Home Depot's 1,200 sq ft title conflicts with the 4,500 sq ft listed for sibling models); price is null (D&S shows "Item Not Available / Sold out" with no price, and no other price-bearing page for this exact model was fetchable); release year null (not stated on any fetched page). Re-fetched and re-verified 2026-07-10; all six non-null spec values confirmed verbatim.

DehumidifierBuyersGuide's model-specific hands-on review confirmed the 16-pint water tank, both a rear gravity-drain (garden hose) outlet and a side pump outlet (continuous drain supported), and the manufacturer-specified 50 pints/day rate, and it provided reviewer-measured noise of 64.8 dB on low and 67.1 dB on high fan speed (source states "dB"; spec unit corrected from dBA to dB to match verbatim). Price left null: no fetched retailer page yielded a hard figure (Lowe's and eBay 403, Klarna and Instacart empty), and the review only says it "regularly retails for just under $300." No release year is explicitly stated on any fetched page (the review calls it "fairly new on the market"), so releaseDate is null.
